name: admin-python-prepare-for-migration-accepts-and-schedules-shutdown
description: With the operator header the route answers at once -- before the drain runs -- with `draining: true` and the two deadlines, then drains, releases orphan M/E grants and shuts the coordinator down in the background. Safe to run as a fixture: the workspace is empty, so the drain has nothing to release, and coordinator shutdown is idempotent, so the harness tearing it down concurrently is a no-op for whichever call is second.
